label: the 200 goes back through res.json() (EQUIVALENT — our ETag is already set)
why: installed Express supplies an ETag only when the response does not already carry one, and the 200 path sets ours before sending — so res.json() and res.end() emit identical headers here. This mutant encodes the belief the original comment got wrong; kept, declared, and explained rather than deleted, so nobody re-adds it as a real one. The hazard res.end() actually closes is on the ERROR responses, where we set no ETag — that is b2-11, and it is killed.
